answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the marble log shows the live set and the comet audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 453 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 62 aliases alive therefore means 62 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the nadir quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
